SELECT m.Model
FROM cars_data cd
JOIN model_list m ON cd.Id = m.ModelId
ORDER BY CAST(cd.Horsepower AS DOUBLE) ASC
LIMIT 1;

FROM cars_data AS cd
JOIN model_list AS ml ON cd.Id = ml.ModelId

```sql

LIMIT 1;
```

SELECT

```sql
SELECT AirportCode
FROM (
    SELECT SourceAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS flight_cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY SourceAirport
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DestAirport AS AirportCode, COUNT(*) AS flight_cnt
    FROM flights
    GROUP BY DestAirport
) AS combined
GROUP BY AirportCode
ORDER BY SUM(flight_cnt) ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT a.Airline, a.Abbreviation, a.Country
FROM airlines AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM flights f
        WHERE f.Airline = a.uid
          AND f.SourceAirport = 'CVO'
      )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM flights f
        WHERE f.Airline = a.uid
          AND f.SourceAirport = 'APG'
      );
```

```sql
WITH address_student_counts AS (
    SELECT
        a.address_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT s.student_id) AS student_cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT current_address_id AS address_id FROM Students
        UNION ALL
        SELECT permanent_address_id FROM Students
    ) AS addr
    JOIN Students s ON s.student_id = s.student_id  -- dummy join to keep distinct count per address
    JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = addr.address_id
    GROUP BY a.address_id
),
max_count AS (
    SELECT MAX(student_cnt) AS max_cnt FROM address_student_counts
)
SELECT
    a.address_id,
    a.line_1,
    a.line_2
FROM address_student_counts asc
JOIN max_count mc ON asc.student_cnt = mc.max_cnt
JOIN Addresses a ON a.address_id = asc.address_id
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT
    cl.Language,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.Code) AS NumAsianCountries
FROM country c
JOIN countrylanguage cl
    ON c.Code = cl.CountryCode
WHERE c.Continent = 'Asia'
GROUP BY cl.Language
ORDER BY NumAsianCountries DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql

    c.GovernmentForm,
    SUM(c.Population) AS TotalPopulation
FROM
    country AS c
WHERE
    c.LifeExpectancy IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    c.GovernmentForm
HAVING
    AVG(c.LifeExpectancy) > 72;
```

FROM Highschooler;

FROM Highschooler
GROUP BY grade
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 4;

```sql
SELECT
    h.name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.friend_id) AS num_friends
FROM
    Highschooler h
LEFT JOIN
    Friend f
    ON h.ID = f.student_id
GROUP BY
    h.name
ORDER BY
    h.name;
```

SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler AS h
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id, COUNT(*) AS friend_count
    FROM Friend
    GROUP BY student_id
) AS f ON h.ID = f.student_id
ORDER BY f.friend_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

```sql
SELECT hs.name
FROM Highschooler hs
JOIN Friend f ON hs.ID = f.friend_id
WHERE f.student_id = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Highschooler
    WHERE name = 'Kyle'
);
```

SELECT COUNT(*) AS kyle_friend_count
FROM Friend f
JOIN Highschooler h ON f.student_id = h.ID
WHERE h.name = 'Kyle';

SELECT h.ID
FROM Highschooler AS h
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Friend AS f
    WHERE f.student_id = h.ID
);

```sql
SELECT h.name,
       COUNT(l.liked_id) AS num_likes
FROM   Highschooler h
JOIN   Likes l
       ON h.ID = l.student_id
GROUP BY h.name
ORDER BY h.name;
```

```sql
SELECT h.name
FROM Highschooler h
JOIN (
    SELECT student_id
    FROM Friend
    GROUP BY student_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT friend_id) >= 2
) f ON h.ID = f.student_id
WHERE h.grade > 5;
```

SELECT COUNT(*) AS like_count

```sql
SELECT d.name
FROM Dogs d
JOIN Owners o ON d.owner_id = o.owner_id
WHERE (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.cost_of_treatment), 0)
    FROM Dogs d2
    JOIN Treatments t ON d2.dog_id = t.dog_id
    WHERE d2.owner_id = o.owner_id
) <= 1000;
```

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name AS first_name
FROM Professionals p
WHERE p.first_name NOT IN (SELECT d.name FROM Dogs d)
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT o.first_name AS first_name
FROM Owners o
WHERE o.first_name NOT IN (SELECT d.name FROM Dogs d);

    p.role_code,
    p.email_address
FROM
    Professionals p
LEFT JOIN
    Treatments t
ON
    p.professional_id = t.professional_id
WHERE

SELECT DISTINCT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM Professionals p
JOIN Treatments t ON p.professional_id = t.professional_id
WHERE t.cost_of_treatment < (SELECT AVG(cost_of_treatment) FROM Treatments);
